notes: Shopify store on a custom 'xtra' theme. IMPORTANT: this domain failed to resolve for the sandboxed browser tool (net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED) despite resolving fine via a direct curl fetch from the same host — if a scraper run hits DNS failures here, it's likely an environment/resolver quirk, not the site being down; verify with a plain curl/requests fetch first. Renders as plain static HTML — no JS rendering needed for the collection grid itself. Confirmed via <nav class="n6pg"><ol> pagination control: page 1 active, up to page 6 shown, '?page={page}' URL pattern confirmed by both this nav and a <link rel="next"> tag in <head>. Stock: each product_container li.product-card gets an extra 'unavailable' class when out of stock (container-class check, same pattern as tcgkauppa.fi) AND contains a redundant descendant p.stock element with class 'overlay-valid' (in stock, incl. 'low-stock' variant) or 'overlay-error' (out of stock) — note the markup duplicates this stock paragraph twice per card (one 'list-hide' / one 'list-only' variant for responsive grid-vs-list display toggles) with identical text, so a scraper should dedupe or just take the first match. Price format clean, e.g. '4,95 €', with an optional '.old-price' span for a struck-through original price when discounted.
